column1: # Every scenario of the synexia-mllm extent-store tests (origin/main f616c321987b, private repo, clone under S:/m3-scratch/eb-conv/scout-private/clones/synexia-mllm) classified against the relocated store. MATCH: same visible contract, ported as JUnit. PARTIAL: the matching part is ported, the rest is named. DIFFERENT: the two contracts disagree (the relocated store's rule is asserted). NOT_IN_DONOR: a feature of the oracle's page-allocator design that the donor does not have. NOT_APPLICABLE: no counterpart in Java or in this design. Ported tests: src/test/java/jdk/m3/file/M3DurableExtentStoreOracleTest.java.
